title: Counter check-in
description: Arrival only — boarding is confirmed on each boat’s manifest.
todaysDepartures: Today’s departures and the next boat
emptyDescription: Try the diver’s name, email, or full booking ID.
emptyQuietDescription: Divers appear here around their departure time. Nothing is in that window right now — the schedule has the rest of the week.
emptyNoTripsDescription: The counter fills itself from your schedule. Put a boat on the board and everyone booked on it turns up here.
clearedBody: Anything new — a walk-in, a late booking — shows up here as it arrives.

notice.notReady: Readiness changed. <guestsLink>Open Guests to resolve the blocker</guestsLink>, then try again.
notice.notBookable: That booking is no longer available for check-in.
notice.notFound: That booking could not be found.
notice.staffNotFound: Your staff access could not be confirmed.
notice.invalid: Choose a diver from the queue before checking in.
notice.waiverInPerson: Paper waiver recorded — signed and on file.
notice.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver — or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notice.waiverError: That paper waiver couldn’t be recorded. Try again, or open the diver’s trip to see why.
notice.walkinAdded: Added to this boat’s list — check them in when they arrive.
notice.walkinAddedWaiverUndelivered: Added to this boat’s list — but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Send it or share the link from their row below.
notice.walkinFull: That boat is full — try the wait list from its trip page instead.
notice.walkinAlready: That diver is already on this boat.
notice.walkinUnavailable: Can’t add this diver to that boat right now — open its trip page for the reason.
notice.walkinInvalid: Choose a boat and enter a name before adding a walk-in.

walkIn.title: Walk-in
walkIn.description: Pick today’s boat, then find the diver or add them fresh — no email required at the counter.
walkIn.tripEmpty: No boats sail in the next day and a half — check the schedule instead.
walkIn.changeTrip: Not this one? Pick a different boat.
walkIn.handEntryDescription: Email is optional — the crew can collect it later. A name is enough to get them on the boat now.
